nodes.label: Day/night (cosmetic)
nodes.rationale: Not the hillshade input; changes no prediction

nodes.label: Elevation range
nodes.rationale: Chosen inside Covertype's elevation range so the model is not asked about unseen heights

nodes.label: Saved world (SavedWorld recipe)
nodes.rationale: Stores recipe only, never heightmap or predictions

nodes.label: settings store (localStorage graze.settings.v1)
nodes.rationale: All reads/writes in try/catch; falls back to defaults

nodes.label: Separate sim and render clocks
nodes.rationale: Tick rate does not depend on frame rate

nodes.label: Deleted drifted terrain-input copies
nodes.rationale: Copies in packages/sim/terrain and app placeholder drifted (old sun angles, chamfer distance)

nodes.label: 250 ms debounced prediction with sequence check
nodes.norm_label: 250 ms debounced prediction with sequence check

nodes.label: Herd simulation (not ML)
nodes.rationale: Nothing learns from data; ecology.json hand-tuned, labeled 'Assumptions, not model output'.

nodes.label: Model Report reads model_card.json
nodes.rationale: Numbers exactly what pipeline produced; retrain updates report; missing file shown not stale.

nodes.label: Web Worker inference
nodes.rationale: Predicting 16,384 cells on main thread would freeze page; also keeps data in browser.

nodes.label: Animal pace (paceScale from ecology.json, D16)
nodes.rationale: Only wall-clock tick rate changes, so determinism is untouched.

nodes.label: getGroundHeight / sampleHeight bilinear convention
nodes.rationale: Interpolation instead of nearest cell keeps walking smooth.

nodes.label: Walk mode (D8)
nodes.rationale: Diorama scale: one world unit is a 30 m cell, walker is a giant; true walking speed would take 45 minutes to cross.

nodes.label: Reviewer gate for features.ts and eval scripts
nodes.norm_label: reviewer gate for features.ts and eval scripts

nodes.label: Tech stack (Svelte, Vite, three.js, Hono, Cloudflare)
nodes.norm_label: tech stack (svelte, vite, three.js, hono, cloudflare)

nodes.label: cf/config bindings helpers
nodes.rationale: Bindings declared in cloudflare.config.ts; generated Env type used, never hand-written

nodes.label: cf CLI (not wrangler)
nodes.rationale: cf is in beta; project must not add a wrangler config

nodes.label: @graze/features single source of truth
nodes.rationale: Both ml/ and apps/web import it so preprocessing cannot drift

nodes.label: Relative-path imports instead of workspace
nodes.rationale: cf beta refuses pnpm workspace root

nodes.label: No pnpm packages workspace
nodes.rationale: cf (beta) cannot build from a workspace root; Worker lives at repo root

nodes.label: Softmax regression (selected model)
nodes.rationale: Random forest scored best but softmax within 0.01 and simplest, so selection rule picks it

nodes.label: Why TypeScript instead of Python
nodes.rationale: Same features module for training and app prevents preprocessing drift

nodes.label: Simulation is not ML
nodes.rationale: Numbers picked by hand for plausible dynamics; kept visible and separate from predictions

nodes.label: Four wilderness areas (Rawah, Neota, Comanche Peak, Cache la Poudre)
nodes.norm_label: four wilderness areas (rawah, neota, comanche peak, cache la poudre)

nodes.label: splits.ts (locked test, LOAO folds, leakage checks)
nodes.norm_label: splits.ts (locked test, loao folds, leakage checks)

nodes.label: Excluded columns (soil, roads, fire points, wilderness)
nodes.norm_label: excluded columns (soil, roads, fire points, wilderness)
nodes.rationale: Generated terrain has no soils, roads, fire history or wilderness boundaries

nodes.label: Leave-one-wilderness-area-out (LOAO)
nodes.rationale: Honest test of generalization to unseen land; used for model selection

nodes.label: Macro-F1
nodes.rationale: Headline metric because two classes dominate and accuracy hides rare ones

nodes.label: Model selection rule
nodes.rationale: Simpler model within 0.01 macro-F1 of best wins; written before any LOAO result

nodes.label: LockedTestSet / splits.lock.json
nodes.rationale: Prevents training code from reading final test indices.

nodes.label: Random-split smoke test before rule freeze
nodes.norm_label: random-split smoke test before rule freeze
nodes.rationale: Sized grids and forest caps; depth-18 trees >700k nodes so forest capped at 25 trees depth 12.

nodes.label: Single seeded PRNG (ml/src/lib/rng.ts)
nodes.rationale: Same commit and data give the same model.

nodes.label: Splits: locked final test, random 80/20, LOAO folds (D3)
nodes.norm_label: splits: locked final test, random 80/20, loao folds (d3)

nodes.label: Shared contract (heightmap, cover map, model output)
nodes.norm_label: shared contract (heightmap, cover map, model output)

nodes.label: Model selection rule (D4), frozen before LOAO results
nodes.norm_label: model selection rule (d4), frozen before loao results
nodes.rationale: Forest counts least simple: largest export, least inspectable.

nodes.label: From-scratch TypeScript training, no ML dependency (D1)
nodes.norm_label: from-scratch typescript training, no ml dependency (d1)
nodes.rationale: Avoids dependencies and format conversion; a repo forest exports straight to model.json; training runs in minutes.

nodes.label: Default relief 20% of elevation range
nodes.rationale: Full range gives slopes far outside training data, flagging most cells OOD

nodes.label: Scaler
nodes.rationale: Fit on training folds only and shipped in model.json so app standardizes exactly as training

nodes.label: Render on demand in orbit view
nodes.norm_label: render on demand in orbit view

nodes.label: Day/night cannot change predictions
nodes.rationale: No world file imports @graze/features; test enforces it

nodes.label: Own sky and water shaders
nodes.rationale: three's Sky needs tone mapping that shifts overlay colors; Water renders scene twice

nodes.label: 2x vertical exaggeration
nodes.rationale: Affects drawing only, never heightmap or model inputs

nodes.label: Not stored: predictions, names, IPs
nodes.rationale: Privacy; unknown fields rejected

nodes.label: Offline share code (graze1. deflate base64url)
nodes.rationale: Sharing works where Worker is not deployed

nodes.label: WORLDS_RATE_LIMIT binding (10/60s)
nodes.rationale: Approximate per-location limits accepted; strict limits not used

nodes.label: OOD cells render sparse and desaturated
nodes.norm_label: ood cells render sparse and desaturated

nodes.label: Vegetation instanced by predicted cover class (D9)
nodes.norm_label: vegetation instanced by predicted cover class (d9)

nodes.label: Ambient backdrop is the walk view (D14, option B)
nodes.norm_label: ambient backdrop is the walk view (d14, option b)
nodes.rationale: Sandbox keeps orbit/brush/overlays untouched and backdrop never needs input.

nodes.label: One flat constant dim (DIM_IDLE 0.84, D20)
nodes.rationale: Raised to 0.84 so secondary text keeps 4.5:1 contrast against brightest frame.

nodes.label: Exit walk mode button and info/settings panel (D15)
nodes.norm_label: exit walk mode button and info/settings panel (d15)
nodes.rationale: Pointer lock hides cursor, so 'Esc to exit' hint is needed.

nodes.label: Feature ablations (hillshade, water distances, all features)
nodes.norm_label: feature ablations (hillshade, water distances, all features)

nodes.label: Macro-F1 metric
nodes.rationale: Two classes are ~85% of rows, so accuracy misleads; macro-F1 weights classes equally.

nodes.label: Model card: Project Graze habitat classifier
nodes.norm_label: model card: project graze habitat classifier

nodes.label: Leave-one-area-out (LOAO) evaluation
nodes.rationale: Random split is optimistic because neighbouring 30 m cells are correlated; LOAO tests an unseen landscape.

nodes.label: Model selection rule (highest mean LOAO macro-F1, simpler within 0.01)
nodes.norm_label: model selection rule (highest mean loao macro-f1, simpler within 0.01)
nodes.rationale: Forest had best mean 0.390 but softmax within 0.01 and simplest, so softmax selected.

nodes.label: Generated-terrain low-trust rate (~12%)
nodes.rationale: Out-of-range mostly from horizontal distance to water exceeding 1,397 m in far map corners.

nodes.label: Out-of-distribution low-trust flag (detector or range check)
nodes.norm_label: out-of-distribution low-trust flag (detector or range check)

nodes.label: standardized-distance OOD detector (99th percentile)
nodes.rationale: 99% keeps false alarms rare on real terrain while flagging extreme fixture; only detector app runtime supports.

nodes.label: Content and safeguards for walk mode (D13)
nodes.norm_label: content and safeguards for walk mode (d13)

nodes.label: D12 Documentation for the walkable world
nodes.norm_label: d12 documentation for the walkable world

nodes.label: How predictions are shown (visualization, not observation)
nodes.norm_label: how predictions are shown (visualization, not observation)
nodes.rationale: A good-looking world is not evidence of accuracy.

nodes.label: model_card.json
nodes.rationale: Source of truth for every number; if model-card.md disagrees, the JSON is right.

nodes.label: modelVersion / schemaVersion versioning and saved-world compatibility
nodes.norm_label: modelversion / schemaversion versioning and saved-world compatibility

nodes.label: validateForm two-tier validation
nodes.rationale: Impossible values blocked; out-of-training-range allowed but flagged so extrapolation is shown.

nodes.label: D9 freeze: run ml:evaluate-final once
nodes.rationale: Test set can only be used once

nodes.label: Dirty-region re-prediction fallback
nodes.rationale: Full grid ~20 ms per edit off main thread; dirty region ~60x cheaper.

nodes.label: D10 Inference support for walk mode
nodes.norm_label: d10 inference support for walk mode

nodes.label: Stable class order contract
nodes.rationale: Cover map, vegetation meshes and tints are keyed by class index; reorder requires notice and modelVersion bump.

nodes.label: heightmapToInputs (@graze/features)
nodes.rationale: Same code used by training and the app, so preprocessing cannot drift.

nodes.label: computeFeatures (@graze/features)
nodes.rationale: Training uses the same function, so preprocessing cannot drift.

nodes.label: Hillshade: our method vs dataset (fitted SUN)
nodes.norm_label: hillshade: our method vs dataset (fitted sun)
nodes.rationale: Astronomical sun positions mismatch dataset columns; grid-searched sun reproduces them, so SUN in @graze/features is fitted.

nodes.label: Cosmetic day/night cycle (D10)
nodes.rationale: Visual sun is not the hillshade feature; a test fails if world/ imports feature code.

nodes.label: Open questions for humans (D7 explain, D9 freeze)
nodes.norm_label: open questions for humans (d7 explain, d9 freeze)

nodes.label: Perturbation sensitivity (±10% of range)
nodes.rationale: Local one-at-a-time perturbation, not causal reasoning.
